blocks.en: Abstract
blocks.zh: 摘要

blocks.en: Occupancy world models struggle to forecast moving objects due to motion uncertainty and shape distortion. A single trajectory can average plausible futures into an implausible path, and repeated re-voxelization can erode or inflate object shape even under correct motion. We introduce ShoWorld to address these challenges through separate motion and shape representations. The motion forecaster predicts probabilistic trajectories conditioned on scene layout, nearby agents and the future ego trajectory. Each hypothesis is rendered into occupancy and fused according to its probability to retain alternative futures. The shape component predicts sub-voxel points with occupancy probabilities and offsets from local geometry. These points move rigidly with the object, and voxel occupancy follows the probability that at least one occupied point falls within it. This representation reduces shape distortion under motion. ShoWorld achieves state-of-the-art results on Occ3D-nuScenes. With ground-truth occupancy and ego trajectory, it improves mIoU and IoU by 6.56 and 9.16 points overall and by 6.06 and 5.53 points on dynamic classes.
blocks.zh: 由于运动不确定性和形状扭曲,占用世界模型难以预测移动物体。 单一的轨迹可以平均地将可能的未来推向不可信的路径,反复的重排化甚至可以在正确的运动下侵蚀或膨胀物体形状. 我们介绍ShoWorld,以便通过不同的动议和形式来应对这些挑战。 运动预报器预测以场景布局为条件的概率轨迹,附近的物剂和未来自负轨迹. 每种假说都变为占用,并根据其保留替代期货的概率加以融合。 形状组件预测带有占用概率的子伏塞尔点,并抵消了局部几何. 这些点与物体一起刚性移动, Voxel 占用时会遵循至少一个被占用点落入其中的概率. 这种表述减少了运动中的形状扭曲。 ShoWorld在Occ3D-nuScens上取得最新成绩. 随着地面真实的占用和自我的轨迹,它提高了mIoU和IoU的总的6.56和9.16分,在动态类上提高了6.06和5.53分.

blocks.en: 1 Introduction
blocks.zh: 导言

blocks.en:
Occupancy world models forecast the evolution of 3D semantic occupancy and provide a unified representation for prediction, planning and simulation in autonomous driving [ 46 , 15 , 38 , 3 ] .
Most generate future scenes in a compressed latent space through autoregressive token prediction [ 46 , 13 ] , large language models [ 35 , 37 ] or diffusion transformers [ 33 , 11 , 14 ] .
Dedicated scene tokenizers further support this representation [ 40 , 20 ] .
Recent methods separate ego motion from scene changes through pose-based warping of static voxels or scene features [ 44 , 9 ] , or forecast the scene in the current frame before generation [ 27 ] .
GAST [ 9 ] models the remaining dynamics implicitly through pose-conditioned feature modulation and attention.
These advances improve forecasting accuracy, but moving objects remain substantially harder to predict than static regions. Fig. 1 shows that dynamic mIoU falls 10.8–13.8 points below static mIoU.
The gap grows from 7–9 points in the first second to 11–18 points in the third.

blocks.en:
We identify two challenges behind this gap: predicting where objects move and preserving their shape under motion. Fig. 2 (a) illustrates the ambiguity of future motion.
A vehicle approaching an intersection may continue straight or turn, and a pedestrian at the curb may wait or cross. Fig. 2 (b) shows that even correct motion does not guarantee correct occupancy.
An object represented by voxels must be re-voxelized after a rotation or a translation that does not align with the grid.
This discretization can create holes or alter object extent, with errors that grow over the prediction horizon.
Our analysis shows that re-voxelization under ground-truth motion still misplaces about 22% of moving-object voxels within the first second and 35% in the third.

blocks.en:
Existing methods generally couple motion and shape within scene-level prediction.
Most generate future occupancy without explicit object trajectories [ 46 , 35 , 37 , 40 , 33 , 11 , 14 , 13 , 20 , 27 , 9 ] .
Others model motion through a single deterministic flow field [ 44 ] .
Generative models can represent diverse futures but do not explicitly separate uncertainty in object motion from errors in object shape.
When one deterministic prediction must explain several plausible motions, voxel-wise supervision can favor a compromise between valid outcomes or spread occupancy across them.
Joint supervision of motion and shape compounds this ambiguity: a network can blur or enlarge an object to compensate for its uncertain position.
The central challenge is therefore to represent alternative motions without allowing positional uncertainty to distort the shape.
blocks.zh:
现有方法一般在场景层面的预测中将运动和形状相配.
多数生成未来没有明确物体轨迹的占用[46、35、37、40、33、11、14、13、20、27、9]。
其他通过单一确定流场的模型运动 [44].
基因模型可以代表不同的未来,但没有明确区分物体运动中的不确定性和物体形状的错误.
当一个决定性的预测必须解释几个合理的动议时,通过阴道监督可以赞成在有效结果之间达成妥协,或者将占用范围扩大。
对运动和形状的联合监督使这种模糊性更为复杂:一个网络可以模糊或扩大一个物体以补偿其不确定的地位.
因此,主要的挑战是,在不容许立场不确定性扭曲形状的情况下,提出其他动议。

blocks.en:
We introduce ShoWorld to address motion uncertainty and shape preservation through separate components.
The motion forecaster predicts multiple future trajectories and their probabilities for each moving object.
Each object uses the surrounding drivable space and obstacles as context.
Relative poses guide attention to nearby agents and the future trajectory of the ego vehicle.
Multimodal prediction is well established in trajectory forecasting [ 8 , 25 , 26 ] , where hypotheses are evaluated against annotated trajectories.
ShoWorld connects these hypotheses to occupancy prediction by rendering the object under each hypothesis and fusing the results according to their probabilities.
The occupancy loss thus supervises both trajectories and probabilities.
This formulation retains the occupancy contribution of each plausible motion without forcing distinct trajectories into an intermediate path.
blocks.zh:
我们引入了ShoWorld,通过单独的组件来解决运动不确定性和形状保存.
运动预测器预测出每个运动物体的多条未来轨迹及其概率.
每个物体使用周围可驾驶空间和障碍作为上下文.
相对的引领了对附近特工的注意,以及自负飞行器的未来轨迹.
多式联运预测在轨迹预测[8、25、26]中已经确立,其中根据附加说明的轨迹评价假设。
ShoWorld将这些假说与占用预测联系起来,方法是在每种假说下使出物体,并根据其概率来调节结果.
因此,占用损失既监督轨道,也监督概率。
这种提法保留了每种可能动的占用因素,而不会迫使不同的轨道进入中间路径。

blocks.en:
The shape component represents each object with sub-voxel points whose occupancy probabilities and offsets are inferred from local geometry.
These points move with the object, and the renderer computes each voxel occupancy probability from the probability that at least one occupied point falls within it.
This finer spatial coverage reduces discretization artifacts under translation and rotation.
We supervise shape under ground-truth motion to prevent trajectory errors from driving geometric distortion.
Motion hypotheses therefore represent uncertainty about future position while the shape component learns the object geometry.
blocks.zh:
外形部分代表每个带有子伏克塞尔点的物体,其占用概率和相抵率是从局部几何推断出.
这些点会随物体而移动,而由渲染器从至少一个被占用点落入其中的概率来计算出每个阴道占用概率.
这种更细化的空间覆盖减少了翻译和旋转下的光碟化文物.
我们通过地面真实运动来监督形状 防止轨道误差导致几何扭曲
因此,运动假说代表未来位置的不确定性,而形状组件则学习对象几何.

blocks.en: Our contributions are as follows. • We propose a multi-hypothesis motion forecaster conditioned on scene layout, nearby agents and the ego trajectory. Probability-weighted fusion of renderings connects multimodal motion prediction to occupancy supervision. • We identify re-voxelization as a source of shape degradation even under ground-truth motion and propose a sub-voxel point representation with separate shape supervision to reduce geometric distortion. • ShoWorld sets a state of the art with gains of up to 6.06 points in dynamic mIoU and 5.53 points in dynamic IoU.

blocks.en: 2 Related Work
blocks.zh: 2 相关工作

blocks.en:
3D Occupancy Prediction. 3D semantic occupancy prediction estimates voxel occupancy and class labels.
The task extends semantic scene completion on SemanticKITTI [ 1 ] to surround-view scenes through dense benchmarks [ 29 , 34 , 36 ] on nuScenes [ 5 ] . Camera-based methods lift image features into 3D.
MonoScene [ 7 ] connects 2D and 3D UNets through feature projection, and TPVFormer [ 12 ] uses three orthogonal planes.
VoxFormer [ 16 ] densifies depth-based voxel queries with a masked autoencoder.
SurroundOcc [ 36 ] , BEVFormer [ 18 ] and CGFormer [ 43 ] aggregate features through spatial cross-attention.
STCOcc [ 19 ] jointly predicts occupancy and scene flow.
VisHall3D [ 21 ] reconstructs visible regions before hallucinating occluded geometry. LiDAR-based methods complete sparse point clouds through contextual shape priors [ 39 ] , semantic-geometric fusion [ 41 , 22 ] or knowledge distillation from adjacent frames [ 32 ] . Camera-LiDAR fusion combines image semantics with point-cloud geometry.
OpenOccupancy [ 34 ] provides multimodal baselines.
Co-Occ [ 23 ] regularizes fusion through volume rendering, and OccGen [ 31 ] uses diffusion for occupancy prediction.
Other methods refine view transformation through attention or LiDAR depth [ 48 , 10 ] .
These methods reconstruct the current scene, while ShoWorld forecasts its evolution.

任务扩展了语义场景在语义KITTI上完成[1],通过密集的基准来包围-取景场景[29,34,36] 在nuScenes上 [5]. 基于相机的方法将图像特性提升到3D.
单景 [7] 连接 二维和 三维 UNets通过特性投影,而TPVFormer [12] 使用3个正交平面.

Occupancy World Models. World models predict scene evolution through latent features for end-to-end driving [ 17 , 47 ] or sensor data for closed-loop simulation [ 42 , 38 ] .
Occupancy world models forecast 3D semantic occupancy.
Most methods generate future occupancy in a compressed latent space.
OccWorld [ 46 ] forecasts VQ-VAE tokens [ 30 ] with a GPT-like spatiotemporal transformer [ 4 ] .
OccSora [ 33 ] , DOME [ 11 ] and DynamicCity [ 3 ] apply diffusion transformers [ 24 ] to 4D tokens, continuous latents and HexPlanes [ 6 ] , respectively.
OccLLaMA [ 35 ] unifies occupancy, language and action in an LLM vocabulary.
Occ-LLM [ 37 ] uses separate codebooks for movable and static voxels.
RenderWorld [ 40 ] separately encodes free and occupied space with self-supervised Gaussian labels.
UniScene [ 14 ] generates occupancy from layouts to condition video and LiDAR synthesis.
PreWorld [ 15 ] forecasts occupancy from cameras after pretraining with 2D labels through volume rendering.
I 2 -World [ 20 ] improves tokenization efficiency within and across scenes.
OccTENS [ 13 ] uses temporal next-scale prediction to jointly model occupancy and ego motion.
Other methods separate ego motion from scene changes.
DFIT-OccWorld [ 44 ] warps static voxels with ego poses and dynamic voxels with predicted flow.
COME [ 27 ] conditions diffusion on a current-frame scene forecast through ControlNet [ 45 ] .
GAST [ 9 ] warps scene features and models residual dynamics through pose-conditioned modulation and attention.
These methods improve static reconstruction but model object motion implicitly or deterministically.
ShoWorld predicts probabilistic trajectories and sub-voxel object shapes.

blocks.en:
Object Tokens. We first encode the context of each object, i.e . its own state, the surrounding layout, and its interactions with nearby agents and the ego vehicle.
For each object 𝒪 i \mathcal{O}_{i} , we compute its center 𝐩 i \mathbf{p}_{i} , its heading θ i \theta_{i} , and its extent from the second moments of its voxels.
The heading follows the direction of motion for clearly moving objects and the principal axis otherwise.
An object token 𝐳 i \mathbf{z}_{i} is then encoded from the pooled voxel features, the class distribution, the extent, the speed, and the past poses in the object frame.

Scene Layout. We build a bird’s-eye view (BEV) layout map from the current occupancy to encode surface types, obstacles and cell visibility.

A lightweight convolutional encoder processes the map, and its features are sampled within a heading-aligned window that spans 8 m behind the object, 32 m ahead and 8 m to each side.
Adding these features to 𝐳 i \mathbf{z}_{i} provides each object with information about drivable space and obstacles along its likely direction of motion.

Re-Voxelization. A common way to move an object is to transform the centers of its voxels and splat them back onto the grid.
Unless the displacement is a whole number of voxels, each voxel spreads over up to eight cells, and the object becomes thinner where the spread mass is cut by a threshold and thicker where neighboring contributions accumulate, and these errors accumulate as the object keeps moving.
The root cause is that one voxel center is too coarse a sample of the object surface.

blocks.en:
4D Occupancy Forecasting. Tab. 1 shows that ShoWorld achieves the best average mIoU and IoU in all four settings.
With 3D occupancy input and the GT ego trajectory, it surpasses the previous best method GAST [ 9 ] by 6.56 mIoU and 9.16 IoU with consistent gains at every horizon, and its IoU at 3 s (61.03%) even exceeds GAST at 1 s (60.77%).
Compared with DOME [ 11 ] and COME [ 27 ] , which generate the whole scene in a latent space, the mIoU gains reach 26.86 and 19.73 points.
GAST models dynamics implicitly through pose-conditioned feature modulation and attention.
ShoWorld explicitly separates motion from shape through probabilistic trajectory hypotheses and sub-voxel points.
With the predicted ego trajectory, ShoWorld leads GAST by 0.30 mIoU and 1.31 IoU, mainly at 1 s (3.45 and 4.14 points), as the errors of the predicted ego trajectory accumulate at longer horizons.
With camera input, ShoWorld improves mIoU and IoU over GAST-STC by 1.63 and 1.12 points with the ground-truth ego trajectory and by 0.75 and 0.92 points with predicted trajectory.
It achieves the best scores at every horizon in both settings.
These results confirm that gains persist with estimated occupancy.

Long-Term Forecasting. Following [ 9 ] , we extend the forecast to 8 s in Tab. 2 .
ShoWorld exceeds GAST by 16.38 mIoU and 14.27 IoU points on average, and its mIoU at 8 s is even higher than that of GAST at 4 s. Fig. 8 shows that the advantage holds on dynamic classes, where ShoWorld improves the average dynamic mIoU and IoU over COME by 16.88 and 15.44 points, and its values at 8 s still exceed those of COME at 3 s.
Our dynamic mIoU also decays more slowly, keeping 30% of its 1 s value at 8 s, against 23% and 18% for COME and DOME. Fig. 7 illustrates both aspects.
COME gradually loses moving objects, which drift away from their GT outlines and break into fragments by 6 s.
In contrast, our multi-hypothesis forecaster keeps each object close to its GT position up to 8 s, even when the ego vehicle turns, showing more accurate trajectories.
The sub-voxel shape is computed once and transformed rigidly under each hypothesis.
This preserves object geometry and reduces erosion or inflation from re-voxelization.

Zero-Shot Forecasting. Following [ 20 , 9 ] , we apply the model trained on Occ3D-nuScenes to Occ3D-Waymo without fine-tuning.
As shown in Tab. 3 , ShoWorld surpasses GAST by 11.14 mIoU and 8.65 IoU points at 2 Hz and by 11.15 and 9.54 points at 10 Hz.
The mIoU margins at both rates are even larger than that on Occ3D-nuScenes, suggesting that our gains generalize beyond the training dataset.
Our forecast also exceeds Copy&Paste by about 40 mIoU points at both rates, so the model captures how the scene changes instead of repeating the current frame.
We attribute this to our explicit structure, since rigid motion, layout, relative poses, and local geometry are shared across datasets.

Complexity Analysis. Tab. 4 shows the complexity comparison of our method with others, using a single GeForce RTX 3090. ShoWorld has only 7.93 M parameters and 123.22 G FLOPs, 34% and 70% fewer than GAST, while achieving the highest accuracy.
Its parameters are also 56 and 87 times fewer than those of DOME and COME.
This efficiency comes from the scene decomposition, in which the background is transported with the ego pose and only refined, and the dynamic part is handled by a small number of object tokens.
Its latency of 84.91 ms is 2.7 times lower than that of I 2 -World and comparable to that of GAST, as the object-level operations consist of many small kernels bound by launch overhead rather than arithmetic.

blocks.en:
All ablations in Tab. 5 are conducted on Occ3D-nuScenes with 3D occupancy input and the GT ego trajectory, forecasting the next 3 s from 2 s of history, and report the mIoU and the dynamic mIoU averaged over 1 s, 2 s, and 3 s.
Baseline (a) retains the scene decomposition but omits context encoding.
Each object moves rigidly along an initial trajectory estimated from its observed history.
The transformed voxel centers are splatted back onto the grid.
Variant (b) adds context encoding to refine trajectories from object state, scene layout and interactions.
This improves mIoU and dynamic mIoU by 1.71 and 0.62 points, respectively.
These gains show the benefit of context beyond motion history.
Variants (c)–(e) increase the hypothesis count from one in (b) to 2, 4 and 6.
Dynamic mIoU improves at each tested count.
With six hypotheses, mIoU and dynamic mIoU exceed (b) by 3.49 and 6.34 points, respectively.
The dynamic mIoU gain is the largest among all components and highlights the importance of representing alternative futures.
This confirms that fusing hypotheses preserves the multimodality of future motion, which a single trajectory averages out.
(f) and (g) replace the voxel centers with sub-voxel points.
Assigning each point to its nearest voxel in (f) improves the mIoU and the dynamic mIoU by 1.55 and 0.46 points, and the any-hit rule in (g) adds another 2.08 and 1.09 points.
This shows that sub-voxel points keep moving objects shape-faithful, and the any-hit rule further prevents erosion and inflation from re-voxelization.
Training with them gains 1.55 points from (e) to (g), more than removing them only at inference ( Fig. 4 ).
With voxel centers at inference, (g) still reaches 45.66% dynamic mIoU, 1.05 points above (e), as its forecaster has been trained on renderings that preserve object shapes.
Overall, the forecaster improves predictions on where objects go and the sub-voxel shape of what they look like, raising mIoU and dynamic mIoU by 8.83 and 8.51 points. See the supplementary material for more ablations.

blocks.en: 5 Conclusion
blocks.zh: 5 结论

blocks.en:
We presented ShoWorld to address two challenges in occupancy forecasting: uncertainty in future object motion and shape distortion under re-voxelization.
The motion forecaster predicts multiple trajectories and their probabilities from scene layout, nearby agents and the ego trajectory.
Probabilistic fusion of rendered hypotheses retains alternative futures in the occupancy forecast.
The shape component uses sub-voxel points and an any-hit rendering rule to preserve object geometry under motion.
Supervision under ground-truth motion separates shape reconstruction from trajectory errors.
ShoWorld achieves best results on Occ3D-nuScenes with explicit trajectories and faithful shapes.
blocks.zh:
我们介绍了ShoWorld,以应对占用率预测方面的两个挑战:未来物体运动的不确定性和再排出时的形状扭曲。
运动预测器从场景布局,附近物剂和自负轨迹中预测出多条轨迹及其概率.
在占用预测中,对假说进行概率组合保留了其他期货。
外形元件采用子伏克塞尔点和任意撞击渲染规则来保存运动下物体几何.
地面-真实运动的监督将形状重建与轨迹错误区分开来。
ShoWorld在Occ3D-nuScens上以明显的轨迹和忠实的外形取得最佳成绩.

blocks.en:
Limitations. Our method models each object as a rigid body moving in the ground plane, and thus misses articulated motion such as pedestrian limbs.
It also relies on objects grouped from the observed occupancy, whose errors propagate into the forecast.
Since the shape is computed once in the current frame, occluded parts remain missing and objects entering later cannot be forecast.
Fusion also stays below the best hypothesis at longer horizons.
Learning the grouping jointly with the forecast and modeling newly appearing agents are left to future work.

今后的工作要靠与预测一起学习分组和模拟新出现代理人。
